text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's all up in the air, like a windswept
storm of
sakura petals—the Oka Sho's
namesake.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea how it's gonna go down,
Trainer,
but let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka is running in the Oka Sho. If she's
still
eyeing the Derby afterward, we'll
have an
impossible decision to make.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But since she's decided to run, we've got
no other
choice!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho... Looks like a G1 race can
still
shake me. It feels just like when I ran
in the
Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But you know what, Trainer? My way of
thinkin'
has changed since back then.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I didn't care if I lost,
so long
as I
tried—just like you taught me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't said that, I wouldn't even
have been
able to move my feet. But
now...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now I feel like that's not enough
anymore—like I
shouldn't go into races
expecting to lose.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If I'm gonna run, I wanna win. Especially
if Scarlet
is gonna be runnin' too...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna be fine with losin'. I'm
gonna go in
strong and come out the
winner!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, thanks! I'm not a newbie
anymore, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm not ready to flutter down like a
cherry
blossom. I couldn't take it if I fell
while Scarlet
bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm here for you, Scarlet. I chose you
over the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
So show me everything you've got—and
I'll show
you what I can really do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's once reckless coolness has
stabilized into
something
firmer—stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thus, her first Classic race against
her biggest
rival, Daiwa Scarlet, begins!
